meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

howto.what: Claude 会引导你将 OpenClaw 的配置、身份、频道凭证、定时任务等迁移到 NanoClaw v2。它先检测现有安装，然后与你讨论并逐步应用更改。
howto.when: 当你说“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through migrating your OpenClaw installation to NanoClaw v2. It detects the existing setup, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then discusses and applies changes interactively.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".
